note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate and the soldier are both recorded as unknown in the original, so only a worker section is provided; the species was established from the worker alone; literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head dark smoky brown, postclypeus slightly paler, dorsum of thorax and abdomen pale brown, antennae yellow; head sparsely setose, body more densely setose. Total length 4.57–6.10. Head capsule subcircular, slightly longer than wide (length to labral apex 1.50, length to mandibular base 0.95–1.05, maximum width 1.20–1.28); median dorsal spot circular or slightly rhomboidal and weakly raised (diameter 0.13–0.17); Y-shaped suture faint. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2 and divided, segment 4 about equal to segment 2. Postclypeus strongly arched and setose, as long as or slightly more than half as long as wide (length 0.27–0.33, width 0.55–0.58). Labrum dome-shaped (length 0.35, width 0.53). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.38–0.45, width 0.67–0.75). Tibial apical spurs usually 2:2:2, a dorsal spur of the fore tibia sometimes present but very minute.
